name: Upfalling Elver
journal_prompt: A young eel, hand-long and glass-clear, climbing the underside of a floating island through rain that is falling upward. Canon says gravity is warped beneath a shelf and that rainwater goes the wrong way there; this is the animal that uses it. Where the elvers come from is the question -- there is no sea within a day of the sky routes, and no adult has ever been taken from a pool.
placement_note: Placeable since the pools were stamped. Tagged to the underside as well because that is the half of its life a walker on the rim can actually see.
